summary.name: QOwnNotes
summary.one_liner: QOwnNotes is a free, open source markdown note-taking app that stores notes as plain-text files and integrates with Nextcloud and ownCloud.
use_cases: Keeping personal notes as plain-text markdown files
Syncing notes across devices with Nextcloud or ownCloud
Avoiding vendor lock-in for note storage
Scripting and customizing a note-taking workflow
summary.what_it_does: QOwnNotes is a note-taking application that stores all notes as plain-text markdown files on the user's computer. It integrates with Nextcloud and ownCloud so users can sync notes across devices using those services. The page describes it as a native application designed to use little processor and memory. It is described as heavily customizable and scriptable. The listings describe it as including a todo list manager.
notable: Notes stored as plain-text markdown files with no vendor lock-in
Works with Nextcloud Notes and ownCloud for sync
Native app optimized for low CPU and memory use
caveats: Sync depends on external services such as Nextcloud or ownCloud
Page does not state pricing details beyond being open source and freeware in listings
